fuel_consumption.source_quote: Projections based on estimated consumption of four billion gallons and a price of $2.96 per gallon (2014 projected)

instrument_type_details.notes: Portfolio: fixed price swaps, purchased calls, collars (sold put + purchased call), three-ways (collar + higher-strike sold call), four-way collars (collar + higher-strike sold call + lower-strike purchased put). Based on diesel fuel and crude oil. 951M gallons (24%) for 2014 and 309M gallons (8%) for 2015 hedged at Dec 31, 2013. 2014 sensitivity: at +20% fuel prices, hedge gain $0.09/gal; at -20%, hedge loss $0.04/gal. Note 8% of 2015 hedged positions also disclosed (approx).

warnings: 2014 projected fuel consumption: ~4 billion gallons at $2.96/gal

Gallons explicitly disclosed: 951M gal for 2014 (24%), 309M gal for 2015 (8%)
No additional collateral required upon instantaneous 10% fuel price decrease (strong balance sheet)
